notes.golisopodsh: Upstream simulator-specific form ID. Relationship and availability not independently verified.
notes.ditto: Ditto is excluded from open GO Battle League; simulator release flags are not GO release evidence.
notes.shedinja: Shedinja is excluded from open GO Battle League. Nincada does not evolve into Shedinja in GO.
notes.rockruff: Ordinary Rockruff cannot evolve into Dusk Lycanroc. A Dusk-capable Rockruff is a separate form.
notes.aegislash_shield: Battle-triggered form changes are not ordinary evolution; rankings include the upstream battle model.
notes.pikachu_libre: Costume-specific evolution restrictions apply; no evolution is inferred from ordinary Pikachu.
notes.zygarde_10: Uses the GO form-change route and Zygarde Cells, not ordinary evolution.
